propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as offline Jira oracle and passes field values to ObservedJira.PRESENT for drift classification
When prev_snapshot is narrowed to a key-set {jira_key: {}}, field-based classifications silently degrade because empty dicts cause membership checks to pass but field values are absent
bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of prev_snapshot.json that reads the working tree directly, bypassing reconcile_once and clone filters, so existing tests do not catch field-value degradation
Classification must report indeterminate status rather than inferring from empty dicts for cases requiring field values, and use membership-only checks where field values are not required
Against key-set fixtures, drift classification must be identical to full-payload fixtures for membership-sufficient cases and report indeterminate (never false drift) for field-dependent cases
CLI exit codes and JSON output shape must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload prev_snapshot inputs
